Package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.builders

Interface VerticalHeaderBuilder<T extends VerticalHeaderBuilder<T>>

Type Parameters:
T - the type returned by the configuration methods
All Known Subinterfaces:
BraveVerticalRequest, BraveWebRequest, WebHeaderBuilder<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
BraveVerticalSearchRequest, BraveWebSearchRequest
public interface VerticalHeaderBuilder<T extends VerticalHeaderBuilder<T>>
Configures the standard headers of a Brave vertical search request.

The headers declared here are common to every vertical search request.

The subscription token is not configured here; use the query builder's withToken method instead.
